'''Odla Sur''' was a [[Reesarian]] and the mate of [[Phenlass Sur]], who together were a bonded pair. Swearing a vow of companionship as part of their [[marriage]], the two joined the [[Resistance]] together, acting as [[scout]]s and [[soldier]]s at a [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|base]] on the [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]]. Using their precise senses, the couple carried out reconnaissance in the [[jungle]]s outside the base. In [[35 ABY]], the pair attended a meeting at the base where the [[pilot]] [[Poe Dameron]] revealed that the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]] had returned.

==Biography==
Odla Sur was a [[Reesarian]] that [[Marriage|married]] [[Phenlass Sur]] and swore a vow of companionship with the other Reesarian as part of the commitment. The pair joined the [[Resistance]] together during its [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]] and<ref name="TROS VD" /> by [[35 ABY]]<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|IX|Phenlass Sur's appearance}}</ref> they were both stationed in the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on the [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]]. Serving as both [[soldier]]s and [[scout]]s, the couple reconnoitered the outlying [[jungle]] beyond the base's perimeter using their precise senses, detecting [[Water|freshwater]] springs though sound and scent alone. Through examination of the [[Plant|underbrush]], the two Reesarians were also able to plot the migratory patterns of local fauna on Ajan Kloss.<ref name="TROS VD" />

In 35 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> Odla and Phenlass were in the base under the [[CR90 corvette]]<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref> ''[[Tantive IV]]''<ref name="TROS VD" /> when the [[Jedi]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] returned to base after a [[Jedi training|training session]] in the nearby jungle and spoke with [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], leader of the Resistance. The Surs then both attended a meeting held in the base where the [[pilot]] [[Poe Dameron]] revealed to all present that the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]] had returned despite his apparent [[death]]<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref> during the [[Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> Dameron explained that Sidious was constructing a [[Final Order|fleet]] on the [[planet]] [[Exegol]] that would be used to give the [[First Order]] control over [[the galaxy]]. As they listened, the couple stood together under the [[CR90 corvette]]<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref> ''[[Tantive IV]]''<ref name="TROS VD" /> and Odla placed a [[Limb|hand]] on Phenlass's shoulder while leaning in to speak to the other Reesarian.<ref name="TROS" />

==Personality and traits==
Odla Sur had precise senses and sharp [[eye]]sight that could see in [[ultraviolet]] and [[infrared]]. As Odla and Phenlass were a bonded Reesarian pair, they were highly attuned to each others location. Odla had [[Color|red]] skin, red [[hair]], and blue eyes.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Equipment==
While on Ajan Kloss, Odla wore an mostly brown [[Clothing|outfit]] that included [[boot]]s, pants, a [[belt]], a tunic, a shawl, and a [[bandolier]], with a red and white [[scarf]].<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Wizard_61.png|thumb|right|200px|Wizard 61]]
Odla Sur appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']]. Creature performer [[Barbara Fadden]]<ref name="TROS" /> portrayed the character as well as [[Fadda-Rarb Arda]] and [[Faddaff Davenspon]] in the film.<ref name="Fadden">{{WebCite|url=https://www.barbarafadden.com|text=Barbara Fadden – Creature Performer|author=Fadden, Barbara|archivedate=20220404171843}}</ref>

Concept art of Odla Sur titled "Wizard 61" was produced for the film by creature concept designer and senior sculptor [[Ivan Manzella]].<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]''</ref> The character was not identified in the film<ref name="TROS" /> but received a name in ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released alongside the film.<ref name="TROS VD" />
